messages.author: 208520df5a1c57c2
messages.subject: Distance sampling in Wikipedia?
parts:
Hi, I just noticed that there is no entry for Distance Sampling, line
transect, point transect or anything else I could think of in
Wikipedia. Can I respectfully suggest that the good folks at RUWPA
might remedy this glaring omission?

Have a pleasant Halloween!

Daniel Pike.
